display_model.opening_insight: A first shape is emerging: pressure, motion, and emotional bite are landing more clearly than polish. The map also has a few small pockets worth testing.

insight_cards.title: Guitar-heavy alternative is leading
insight_cards.body: The strongest early region is guitar-forward alternative with distortion, urgency, and emotional pressure. Treat this as the center to test first, not a finished identity, and keep the claim focused on sound.

insight_cards.title: The sound shape is converging
insight_cards.body: The clearest musical clues are texture and movement: guitar pressure, purposeful distortion, urgent vocal delivery, compact songcraft, and anthems with bite. This layer should stay central.

insight_cards.title: Older alt may be a bridge
insight_cards.body: Earlier alternative and post-punk seem connected to the main signal, but not settled. This may become a bridge into the center, or a clean boundary where the map stops stretching.

insight_cards.title: Small but clean heavy-rock signal
insight_cards.body: A few body-and-scale rock examples are landing cleanly, without enough volume to call this a center. The pocket is too coherent to ignore, so it needs more evidence.

insight_cards.title: Some fits depend on context
insight_cards.body: A few signals may work by song, album, or era rather than as blanket matches. Unknowns stay open; negative evidence stays cautious until future listening narrows the edge.
